trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Hormuz Strait
trends.summary: Israel completed broad attacks on Iran; Iran rejected ceasefire proposals and threatens response 'beyond the region.' Trump's Tuesday deadline for Strait of Hormuz reopening appears unlikely, with negotiations pessimistic and potential escalation to Iranian infrastructure imminent. Iran blocking all LNG shipments through Hormuz, creating acute global energy supply shock.

trends.name: Oil Price Spike & Energy Sector Revaluation
trends.summary: U.S. crude topped $115/barrel on Iran strike reports; LNG shortage intensifying as Hormuz remains blocked. Energy sector demands fundamental rethink after years of investor neglect—creates major opportunity for energy stocks and inflation hedges. PIMCO warns supply shock will translate to growth shock across economy.

trends.name: Tech Stock Valuation Reset & Buying Opportunity
trends.summary: Goldman Sachs flags 'generational buying opportunity' in U.S. tech; IT sector now trades at much lower valuations vs. 20-year average after recent +50-100% YTD rallies (NVDA +81%, GOOGL +102%). Market pullbacks seen as entry points for quality growth, particularly in QQQ and mega-cap AI beneficiaries.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk & Credit Market Stress
trends.summary: Credit markets facing shock from Iran war escalation; Danone CEO flags price uncertainty as conflict upends supply chains and consumer pricing. Fault lines emerging in credit markets as investors navigate geopolitical uncertainty. Private credit and convertibles becoming tactical hedges.

trends.name: Anthropic Enterprise AI Contract & Meta Dominance
trends.summary: Meta's $900M/month contract with Anthropic (60T tokens) implies ~$10B ARR for Anthropic—largest enterprise AI contract in history. Signals massive AI spending concentration among mega-cap tech firms and validates AI infrastructure buildout thesis. Competitive advantage for cloud/AI infrastructure providers.

trends.name: Defense Contractors & Geopolitical Upside
trends.summary: Iran conflict creating massive opportunity for defense contractors amid elevated geopolitical tensions and military spending surge. Palantir highlighted as difficult-to-replace AI platform at core of defense operations. Defense sector reassessed as inflation hedge and geopolitical proxy.

trends.name: GLP-1 Weight Loss Drug Expansion & Novo Nordisk
trends.summary: Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill launch drawing new patient wave into GLP-1 weight loss market, expanding addressable market beyond injectables. Oral formulation removing barrier to adoption and democratizing weight loss treatment access. Major tailwind for biotech and healthcare sector.

trends.name: Semiconductor Export Controls & China Market Impact
trends.summary: ASML shares fell on proposed U.S. export curbs targeting China chip market already under pressure. India-China thaw on EV trade signals potential geopolitical reopening but semiconductor restrictions remain core friction point. Impacts chip equipment makers and TSMC competitors.

trends.name: AI Job Loss Debate & Employment Impact
trends.summary: Marc Andreessen calls AI job-loss fears 'fake,' expecting net employment gains from AI adoption. BigBear.ai's AI transformation pivot and broader market debate on whether AI drives growth or displacement. Market pricing in productivity gains vs. labor disruption uncertainty.

trends.name: Housing Market Pressure & Demographic Headwinds
trends.summary: Iran war upending spring housing market as energy costs and geopolitical uncertainty hit demand. Broader trend: married homeowners by 30 collapsed from 52% (1960s) to 12% (2025), signaling structural affordability crisis. Housing affordability remains persistent macro headwind.

trends.name: Dividend & Income Strategies In Volatile Markets
trends.summary: Investors rotating to high-dividend payers (OVL 10% yield) and fat dividend stocks as volatility and geopolitical risk rise. Dividend-focused strategies gaining traction as bond alternatives amid uncertainty. Energy Transfer highlighted as 'golden goose' for yield in inflationary environment.

trends.name: Roth IRA Record Contributions & Retail Investing
trends.summary: IRA contributions hit record levels driven by Roth enthusiasm and Gen Z engagement. Signals strong retail investor participation and tax-advantaged savings surge. Reflects retail optimism despite macro uncertainty and housing affordability challenges.
